description: Keep the graded spec-driven-development and documentation artifacts truthful for Issue #18. Add a new favorites requirement to the spec set and document the feature in BOTH READMEs, mirroring how Issue #22 (dark mode / accessibility) and Issue #20 were documented. No code changes.
steps: Append a new numbered requirement to .kiro/specs/mlb-postseason/requirements.md for 'Favorite teams: registration, highlight, header pin, and filter (Issue #18)', mirroring the structure of the existing 'Requirement 15 - Dark mode and accessibility (Issue #22)' and 'Requirement 16 ... (Issue #20)' sections (a short narrative + an 'Acceptance criteria' list). The acceptance criteria MUST capture Issue #18's three criteria verbatim in intent: highlight not color-only (icon + border + a11y label), eliminated teams switch to an 'Eliminated'/'敗退' indication, and EN/JA support; plus persistence to localStorage key mlb.favorites (multiple allowed), the header pin (next game / current series status), and the favorites-only filter with its empty state.

Update .kiro/specs/mlb-postseason/design.md to describe the actual implementation: the PURE favorites store (frontend/src/favorites.ts, key mlb.favorites, guarded parse), the FavoritesContext/useFavorites glue (frontend/src/FavoritesContext.tsx) mounted in main.tsx, the PURE bracket helpers findTeamSeries/isTeamEliminated/favoriteSummary in bracketLayout.ts, the FavoriteToggle component, the non-color highlight treatment (icon + border + aria label), the header pin, and the filter. Reference real file paths. Match the existing design.md tone/sections.
Update .kiro/specs/mlb-postseason/tasks.md to add the Issue #18 work as completed task(s), consistent with how prior issues are listed there.

Add a truthful 'Favorite teams' section to README.md mirroring the existing '### Dark mode and accessibility' section (what the feature does, how the highlight is accessible/not color-only, the eliminated indication, EN/JA, and that favorites persist in localStorage). Place it near the other feature sections.
Add the equivalent section to README.ja.md in Japanese, mirroring the existing '### ダークモードとアクセシビリティ' section so both READMEs stay in parity (the repo keeps EN and JA READMEs in sync).
Do a final read-through to ensure the docs describe the system AS ACTUALLY BUILT in FEAT-001/FEAT-002 (no aspirational claims). Fix any drift.
acceptance_criteria: .kiro/specs/mlb-postseason/requirements.md has a new Issue #18 favorites requirement whose acceptance criteria cover: highlight not color-only (icon + border + a11y label), eliminated -> 'Eliminated'/'敗退', EN/JA, localStorage persistence (mlb.favorites, multiple allowed), header pin, and favorites-only filter + empty state.
design.md and tasks.md are updated to describe the shipped favorites implementation with real file paths and a completed task entry.
README.md and README.ja.md each have a parallel, truthful favorites section matching the depth of the existing dark-mode (#22) sections.
No source/behavior changes in this feature; `npm run build` still passes.
verification: PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH" npm run build (passes; docs-only change does not break the build)
